scriptDescriptions.install:browsers: Install Playwright browser binaries and system dependencies (run after install or when Playwright is upgraded).
scriptDescriptions.test:playwright: Run the full Playwright suite under tests/ with ts-node and tsconfig-paths so src/* imports resolve.
scriptDescriptions.test:playwright:api: Run only API specs under tests/API with the same TypeScript path setup as test:playwright.
scriptDescriptions.test:playwright:ui: Run only UI specs under tests/UI with the same TypeScript path setup as test:playwright.
scriptDescriptions.test:playwright:chromium: Run Playwright tests for the chromium project only (faster local/CI smoke).
scriptDescriptions.playwright:report: Open the last HTML test report (run after a test run that produced playwright-report/).
scriptDescriptions.playwright:codegen: Launch Playwright codegen to record locators and flows against a URL.
scriptDescriptions.lint: Type-check the project with tsc --noEmit (no emit); fails on TS errors in src, tests, and playwright.config.ts.
